answer_1.quote: In this section, we evaluate the performance of five different RPEs (T5   , Shaw, LFHC, XL, GCDF) on text classification, question generation and language modeling.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs include questions in question generation and autoregressively generated text in language modeling.

answer_2.quote: For QQP, the average score of accuracy and f1 is selected as the final evaluation metric. For MNLI, the average score of matched-accuracy and mismatched-accuracy is selected as the final evaluation metric.
